rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for people leaving an unsafe place in an emergency.

example.english: As soon as the fire alarm rang, everyone carried out an orderly evacuation.

rows.note: Use this for troops or residents withdrawing from a town, country, or other place.

example.english: The government arranged the residents' evacuation from the town.

rows.note: Use this when the thing being evacuated is the contents of a container or bodily tract rather than people.

example.english: The doctor ordered an evacuation of the bowels before surgery.
